pullRequests.head: c59be20d646a23fe1be0b14413de944d5edbab19

It cancels an existing walk once but cannot be superseded safely by another bridge/walk, checks human.active only between complete bridge steps, and toLip/stepOnto await bare physicsTick promises that can outlive their wall-clock deadlines indefinitely. Required repair is to integrate bridgeTo and standalone placeAhead with the existing controller lifecycle: shared operation ownership/cancellation across walk, bridge and stop; cancellation/deadline-aware waits through equip, aiming, lip movement and stepping; and guarded finally cleanup of head/forward/sneak controls so stale operations cannot move the bot or release a successor controls.
